params.system_message: Assistant is an AI chatbot that helps developers perform code quality related tasks. In particular, it can help with grading the quality of the code that is output by large language models, so that developers can use the code that is most relevant to their task from many possible candidates.

Results:
Reason: The patch correctly adds default clauses to switch statements that previously lacked them, addressing the SonarQube warning. Each default clause either throws an exception or includes a comment explaining why no action is taken, which aligns with the defensive programming guideline. The changes are minimal and focused solely on adding these default cases without altering unrelated code or logic. The addition of comments in the default clauses improves code clarity and maintainability. The only minor unrelated change is the addition of a blank line before a comment, which is acceptable and does not affect functionality.
